extensions.name: Back to top
extensions.desc: A small button that jumps to the top once you have scrolled down.

extensions.name: GitHub: wide diffs
extensions.desc: Lets diffs, blame and code files use the full screen width.

extensions.name: Hacker News: readable
extensions.desc: Bigger type, wider column and real spacing between comments.

extensions.name: Stack Overflow: wide answers
extensions.desc: Gives the question and answers the full width; code scrolls sideways.

extensions.name: Wikipedia: comfortable reading
extensions.desc: Roomier line height, and infoboxes that fit a phone screen.

extensions.name: YouTube: Shorts off
extensions.desc: Removes the Shorts shelf and the Shorts tab from YouTube.
